'''Henri Veesaar''' (born 28 March 2004) is an Estonian [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] player for the [[Arizona Wildcats men's basketball|Arizona Wildcats]] and [[North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball|North Carolina Tar Heels]]. Listed at {{height|m=2.13}} and {{convert|225|lbs|kg|1}}, he plays the [[Center (basketball)|center]] position.

==College career==
On May 20, 2022, it was announced that Veesaar would leave [[Real Madrid Baloncesto B|Real Madrid youth team]] and would join [[Arizona Wildcats men's basketball|Arizona]] to play [[college basketball]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Veesaar lahkub Madridi Realist ja liitub Kriisa koduülikooliga|url=https://sport.postimees.ee/7527709/veesaar-lahkub-madridi-realist-ja-liitub-kriisa-koduulikooliga}}</ref> During his first season in Arizona, Veesar received little playing time but showed promise in limited action. An injury to his elbow sidelined him for his entire sophomore campaign.<ref>{{cite web|title=Arizona center Henri Veesaar out with elbow injury, per report|url=https://www.azdesertswarm.com/basketball/2023/10/30/23939659/arizona-wildcats-football-henri-veesaar-elbow-injury-report-oumar-ballo-dylan-anderson-krivas-2023|date=31 October 2023|accessdate=21 September 2025}}</ref> After a long recovery period, Veesaar decided to redshirt for the 2023–24 season.<ref>{{cite web|title=Arizona men’s basketball notebook: Wildcats hoping to avoid another road loss, Henri Veesaar to redshirt|url=https://www.azdesertswarm.com/basketball/2024/1/11/24035068/arizona-wildcats-mens-basketball-notebook-henri-veesaar-tommy-lloyd-caleb-love-road-games-ranked|date=12 January 2024|accessdate=21 September 2025}}</ref> During his last season in Arizona, he played in 37 games, averaging 9.4 points per game and became a key contributor to the team.<ref>{{cite web|title=Former Arizona center Henri Veesaar reportedly transfers to North Carolina|url=https://arizonasports.com/ncaa/uofa-basketball/henri-veesaar-unc/3579563/|date=4 April 2025|accessdate=17 November 2025}}</ref>

After spending three seasons in Arizona, Veesaar transferred to [[North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball|North Carolina Tar Heels]] of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Arizona transfer Henri Veesaar commits to the North Carolina men's basketball|url=https://www.dailytarheel.com/article/2025/04/sports-breaking-henri-veesaar-breaking-april-2025|date=4 April 2025|accessdate=21 September 2025}}</ref> Veesaar averaged 17.0 points, 8.7 rebounds, 2.1 assists, 1.5 steals and 1.4 blocks in 31.5 minutes per game and achieving 13 double doubles that season for North Carolina.<ref>{{cite web|title=College basketball rankings: North Carolina tumbles after Henri Veesaar's NBA Draft declaration|url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/college-basketball-rankings-north-carolina-henri-veesaar-nba-draft/|date=24 April 2026|accessdate=29 April 2026}}</ref> He was also chosen to the 2026 [[List of All-Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball teams|All-ACC]] Second-team.<ref>{{cite web|title=UNC basketball's Caleb Wilson, Henri Veesaar make All-ACC teams|url=https://eu.fayobserver.com/story/sports/college/acc/2026/03/09/acc-college-basketball-awards-unc-caleb-wilson-henri-veesaar/89072448007/|accessdate=29 April 2026}}</ref> After one season at North Carolina, Veesaar declared to enter [[2026 NBA draft]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Estonia's Henri Veessaar entering 2026 NBA draft|url=https://news.err.ee/1610006464/estonia-s-henri-veessaar-entering-2026-nba-draft|date=25 April 2026|accessdate=29 April 2026}}</ref>

==National team career==
Veesaar made his debut for the [[Estonia men's national basketball team|Estonian national team]] when he was 17 years old against [[Iceland men's national basketball team|Iceland]] on 29 July 2021.<ref>{{cite web |title= Henri Veesaar avas koondise eest punktiarve võimsa pealtpanekuga|url=https://sport.delfi.ee/artikkel/94160039/video-henri-veesaar-avas-koondise-eest-punktiarve-voimsa-pealtpanekuga}}</ref> He has also represented the [[Estonia men's national under-18 basketball team|Estonia national U-18 team]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Eesti U18 korvpallikoondis lõpetas kõrgetasemelise välisturniiri vägeva võiduga, Veesaar kogus kaksikduubli ja seitse kulpi|url=https://sport.delfi.ee/artikkel/94249865/eesti-u18-korvpallikoondis-lopetas-korgetasemelise-valisturniiri-vageva-voiduga-veesaar-kogus-kaksikduubli-ja-seitse-kulpi}}</ref>
